items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is excluded under §§2.1 and 3.1.4. The clothing and jewellery are also excluded under §§4.3(d) and 4.3(f) as personal belongings taken from a vehicle away from the insured location; the positive estimate is a hypothetical value for the single lot.
Sections 4.3(e) and 5.2.5 exclude the private vehicle and journey-related charges, and no insured building damage occurred. The hypothetical estimate uses the prior of €79 gross for one charge.
